paragraphs.text: Felisa Fang is a vampire wizard who graduated from Silverquill College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios . Nicknamed the Fang of the Silverquill , a play on her surname, she belongs to the Vainglory tradition—a group of Silverquill mages who wield language as both inspiration and reprimand.

As a vampire and the undisputed queen bee of Silverquill, Felisa is known for her sharp style, magnetic popularity, and razor-sharp wit. When favored, she presents herself as the epitome of grace and charm, a role model among her peers. However, crossing her can provoke a swift and relentless retaliation, often backed by her loyal circle of followers. Her verbal attacks are feared, but if words fail to bring her opponent down, she does not hesitate to settle matters through intense after-hours magical duels.
In an attempt to push Felisa's friend Rootha Squallheart to greater action through the power of cutting words, Uvilda Mistcoiler directed Felisa to use her Silverquill magic to "motivate" the orc .
Felisa graduated from Strixhaven between 4562 and 4565 AR .
